rites.name: Graizhugok
rites.text: Graizhugok is the concept of a root-tone sounded through Ilyimeth during the Singing, when the first roots of the world condensed out of drifting resonance. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between tones, it became the sound that held the newborn land together.

rites.name: Shyustith
rites.text: Shyustith is the concept of a hushed resonance that once ran through the bare stone of Ilyimeth as its first roots condensed out of the Singing. In the Age of Strangers, outsiders learned to anchor their own voices to it and trade in its tones.

rites.name: Oriireth
rites.text: Oriireth is a sigil-weaving discipline in which practitioners inscribe living runes onto their own skin and the air, letting each glyph drain stored starlight into a single concentrated burst. Its masters are said to be able to fold a lone sunset's worth of luminous force into a fingertip, though such work is rare and costly.

rites.name: Jorernon
rites.text: Jorernon is the concept of a sleeping power that the makers of Ilyimeth planted into the Weave during the Seeding, when quiet forces were laid down to wait. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds, Jorernon stirred only faintly, its meaning tied to the moment a binding loosened.

rites.name: Thithora
rites.text: Thithora is the concept of the Sundering as the Ilyimeth Arcane Realm understood it, the binding that held shattered worlds apart while the Pact was sworn. It was never a place, only the shared name for the moment when landfall broke old bonds between the Shards. Its power lay in what it refused to let fall further.

rites.name: Elinwen
rites.text: Elinwen is the concept of a hymn-sung boundary in Ilyimeth, a binding that holds the walls of the Walled Age together through the rites of its orders. Her power is to keep a line from breaking, and at her strongest she has sealed a crossing that had threatened to unmake a whole valley.

rites.name: Venerliel
rites.text: Venerliel is a recurring winter festival of the Arcane realm of Ilyimeth, held in its great mirror-court during the longest nights of the year. Its revels are sustained by a chorus of lantern-spirits who sing the year's accumulated kindness into a single radiant crescendo. Every few seasons the festival is refashioned by its keepers, and the old rites give way to new ones.

rites.name: Lyina
rites.text: Lyina is a sealed festival of resonance in the arcane realm of Ilyimeth, held in the sixth era, where luminous wardens perform a daily rite of gratitude for the Veil-Mother. Twice each cycle the sky-lanterns descend along the river of glass, and the choir of bells answers them in ribbons of silver light.

rites.name: Orianuamora
rites.text: Orianuamora is a luminous festival of the Arcane realm in Ilyimeth, held during the E6 era when enchanters gather to kindle wandering sparks into lasting wonder. Its performers weave a chorus of silver bells that draws curious travelers from distant provinces to the glowing court. The event is remembered as the season when the realm's hidden magic was first shared openly with newcomers.

rites.name: Miirla
rites.text: Miirla is a concept in the Ilyimeth omniverse, a veil of resonant glass that hums whenever a sealed charm is broken. It is said to hold the echo of every tide that ever rose on the old moons, making it the quiet anchor of that cosmos's arcane calendar.

rites.name: Nuimaerwen
rites.text: Nuimaerwen is a drifting concept-spirit of the Ilyimeth omniverse that exists only where a story is being told aloud. It can reshape the emotional weather of any tale it inhabits, binding sleeping kingdoms and lifting cursed woodlands into bloom. Its power grows with every listener who believes the unlikely thing it promises.

rites.name: Silionamwen
rites.text: Silionamwen is the Veil of Breath in Ilyimeth's Arcane realm, a concept of drawn-out currents that carry sound, scent, and memory between distant lands. Its practitioners shape the unseen weather of the Sixth Era, guiding pressure and wind in ways that can lift cities or quiet storms.

rites.name: Ilyennora
rites.text: Ilyennora is a sootless candle of hanged-man tallow whose flame burns black and throws no light. Whoever kindles it cannot die until the wick is spent, and any dead it calls back walk again for exactly as long as it burns.

rites.name: Orielys
rites.text: Orielys is a concept of pale, weeping sorcery in Ilyimeth that feeds on the regrets of those who wield it, drawing power from grief rather than will. Its practitioners are rarely wicked by intent, yet every working leaves a hollow in the world where something was once remembered. The art is treated as a quiet contagion that the ageing Choir of Ash tries, without success, to contain.

rites.name: Elimionnora
rites.text: Elimionnora is a veil-weaving discipline in Ilyimeth's arcane era E6, practiced by scholars who bind stray mana into thin lattices of silver thread. Its masters can gather the leylines of a whole hemisphere into a single spark or quiet a storm front by unspooling its charge. The art is feared more for its gentleness than its violence, since a poorly tied lattice can unravel an entire province.

rites.name: Oriamiorla
rites.text: Oriamiorla is a sealed resonance of the Ilyimeth arcane choir, a voice that can be lent to one bearer at a time and that peels stone from the air when it sounds. Its bearers must spend a season of silence before each use, or the resonance turns on them.

rites.name: Miamora
rites.text: Miamora is a verdant hearth-spirit of the Ilyimeth Arcane realm, who kindles dormant embers within trees and turns drifting smoke into living signals. Her gift is strictly secondary, a quiet inheritance granted to those who already walk the sky-roots of the wood.

rites.name: Ryirlys
rites.text: Ryirlys is a resonant lattice-core that drifts through the Ilyimeth arcane realm, feeding on the ambient hum of spells cast near it. When a rival sorcery-engine threatened to unravel the nearby star-bridges, Ryirlys sealed itself into a shell of bent light, sacrificing its own stored resonance to hold the bridges together.

rites.name: Elamualae
rites.text: Elamualae is an ever-burning ember sealed within a lattice of frosted glass, kept alight by the quiet devotion of a bloodline that tends it each dawn. Its flame carries a faint blessing that flows into every descendant and the walls they inhabit, though it cannot be extinguished without unravelling those gifts across the valley. Its keepers speak of it as a steady heart rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Nuema
rites.text: Nuema is a concept of arcane transformation in Ilyimeth, where an afflicted person grows violet crystal blossoms whenever a nearby boy's pulse quickens. The blossoms fold into a glassy cocoon that reshapes the body into a six-armed sylph, and each stage fades after a season, leaving the bearer with translucent wings earned through the change.

rites.name: Lyamerla
rites.text: Lyamerla is a concept of the Ilyimeth Arcane Realm, the notion of a single outcome that the Library of the Three Futures sets on its shelves when the ending branches. During the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it was said to be carried in the ash of kiln-towers and the vows of the Ember Orders.

rites.name: Siliolanae
rites.text: Siliolanae is a concept in Ilyimeth that gives form to the moment a single future is chosen from the branching ends kept on the Library's shelves. Its presence during the Age of Sundering let old bonds between landfall peoples be cut cleanly, leaving each severed tie to find its own new course.
